"""Cognos 第一网页竖切：一个真实、可恢复的沟通发生场。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import os
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import BaseModel


WEB_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = WEB_DIR.parent
PHASE0_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "phase0"
FRONTEND_DIR = WEB_DIR / "frontend"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PHASE0_DIR))

from codex_runtime import (
    CodexRuntimeAdapter,
    JsonThreadStore,
    RuntimeAdapter,
    RuntimeUnavailableError,
)
from gemini_runtime import GeminiRuntimeAdapter, GeminiStateStore
from history import AppendOnlyHistory, HistoryCorruptionError


def _load_env_file(path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.exists():
        return
    try:
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
                continue
            key, _, val = line.partition("=")
            key = key.strip()
            val = val.strip().strip("'\"")
            if key and key not in os.environ:
                os.environ[key] = val
    except Exception:
        pass


_load_env_file(WEB_DIR / ".env")


@dataclass
class Participant:
    id: str
    name: str
    model_name: str
    runtime: RuntimeAdapter
    description: str = ""

    def get_thread_id(self) -> str | None:
        if hasattr(self.runtime, "state_store") and hasattr(self.runtime.state_store, "load"):
            st = self.runtime.state_store.load()
            if isinstance(st, str):
                return st
            elif hasattr(st, "thread_id"):
                return st.thread_id
        return None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "name": self.name,
            "model_name": self.model_name,
            "thread_id": self.get_thread_id(),
            "description": self.description,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AppConfig:
    history_path: Path
    thread_state_dir: Path
    codex_cwd: Path
    participant_instructions_path: Path
    gemini_api_key: str | None = None
    gemini_model: str = "gemini-3.7-flash"


class SendMessageRequest(BaseModel):
    content: str
    target: str | None = None
    quoted_occurrence_id: str | None = None


class ConversationService:
    """串行组织一次发言与特定参与者的 Runtime turn，支持同一发生场内多参与者共在。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        history: AppendOnlyHistory,
        participants: dict[str, Participant],
        default_target_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.history = history
        self.participants = participants
        self.default_target_id = default_target_id or (next(iter(participants.keys())) if participants else "gemini")
        self._send_lock = asyncio.Lock()

    def resolve_target(self, content: str, requested_target: str | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """解析受话参与者。支持 @Codex / @Gemini 语法或显式请求参数。"""
        stripped = content.strip()
        for p_id, p in self.participants.items():
            triggers = [f"@{p.name.lower()}", f"@{p_id.lower()}"]
            for trig in triggers:
                if stripped.lower().startswith(trig):
                    rest = stripped[len(trig):].lstrip(" :,，：\n")
                    return p_id, rest or stripped

        if requested_target and requested_target.lower() in self.participants:
            return requested_target.lower(), stripped

        return self.default_target_id, stripped

    async def send(
        self,
        content: str,
        target: str | None = None,
        quoted_occurrence_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not content.strip():
            raise ValueError("消息不能为空")
        if len(content) > 100_000:
            raise ValueError("单条消息暂不能超过 100000 个字符")

        target_id, target_content = self.resolve_target(content, target)
        if target_id not in self.participants:
            raise ValueError(f"未找到指定的参与者：{target_id}")

        participant = self.participants[target_id]

        quoted_record = None
        if quoted_occurrence_id:
            quoted_record = self.history.get_by_id(quoted_occurrence_id)

        if quoted_record:
            q_author = quoted_record.get("author", "未知参与者")
            q_id = quoted_record.get("id", "")
            q_content = quoted_record.get("content", "")
            actual_input = (
                f"[来自当前发生场的已有发生]\n"
                f"occurrence_id: {q_id}\n"
                f"author: {q_author}\n\n"
                f"{q_content}\n"
                f"[/发生]\n\n"
                f"小林：\n"
                f"{target_content or content}"
            )
        else:
            actual_input = target_content or content

        async with self._send_lock:
            user_record = self.history.append_message(
                author="小林",
                content=content,
                target=participant.name,
                target_participant_id=participant.id,
                quoted_occurrence_id=quoted_occurrence_id if quoted_record else None,
            )
            reply = await participant.runtime.send(actual_input)
            
            ai_record = self.history.append_message(
                author=participant.name,
                author_participant_id=participant.id,
                content=reply.text,
                in_reply_to=user_record["id"],
                quoted_occurrence_id=quoted_occurrence_id if quoted_record else None,
                runtime_ref={
                    "runtime": participant.id,
                    "thread_id": reply.thread_id,
                    "turn_id": reply.turn_id,
                },
            )
            return {
                "user": user_record,
                "reply": ai_record,
                "target": participant.to_dict(),
            }


def default_config() -> AppConfig:
    vault_root = Path(
        os.environ.get(
            "COGNOS_VAULT_PATH",
            str(Path.home() / "Documents" / "Obsidian Vault"),
        )
    ).resolve()

    thread_state_dir = Path(
        os.environ.get(
            "COGNOS_THREAD_STATE_DIR",
            str(WEB_DIR / ".state"),
        )
    ).resolve()
    codex_cwd = Path(os.environ.get("COGNOS_CODEX_CWD", str(PROJECT_DIR))).resolve()

    return AppConfig(
        history_path=vault_root
        / "10 Projects"
        / "Cognos"
        / "运行数据"
        / "第一发生场.jsonl",
        thread_state_dir=thread_state_dir,
        codex_cwd=codex_cwd,
        participant_instructions_path=WEB_DIR / "participant_instructions.md",
        gemini_api_key=os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY"),
        gemini_model=os.environ.get("GEMINI_MODEL", "gemini-3.7-flash"),
    )


def _read_instructions(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"无法读取当前参与说明：{path}") from exc


class DynamicRuntimeWrapper:
    """包装运行时以支持动态注入说明。"""
    def __init__(self, adapter: Any, instructions_path: Path) -> None:
        self.adapter = adapter
        self.instructions_path = instructions_path

    async def send(self, message: str) -> Any:
        self.adapter.developer_instructions = _read_instructions(self.instructions_path)
        return await self.adapter.send(message)


def create_app(
    config: AppConfig | None = None,
    *,
    runtime: RuntimeAdapter | None = None,
    participants: dict[str, Participant] | None = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    config = config or default_config()
    history = AppendOnlyHistory(config.history_path)

    registry: dict[str, Participant] = {}

    if participants is not None:
        registry = dict(participants)
    elif runtime is not None:
        registry["codex"] = Participant(
            id="codex",
            name="Codex",
            model_name="Codex Runtime",
            runtime=runtime,
        )
    else:
        if config.gemini_api_key:
            gemini_store = GeminiStateStore(config.thread_state_dir / "gemini_thread.json")
            gemini_adapter = GeminiRuntimeAdapter(
                api_key=config.gemini_api_key,
                state_store=gemini_store,
                model=config.gemini_model,
            )
            registry["gemini"] = Participant(
                id="gemini",
                name="Gemini",
                model_name=f"Gemini {config.gemini_model.replace('gemini-', '')}",
                runtime=DynamicRuntimeWrapper(gemini_adapter, config.participant_instructions_path),
                description="Google AI API (主通道)",
            )

            gemini_b_store = GeminiStateStore(config.thread_state_dir / "gemini_b_thread.json")
            gemini_b_adapter = GeminiRuntimeAdapter(
                api_key=config.gemini_api_key,
                state_store=gemini_b_store,
                model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            )
            registry["gemini-b"] = Participant(
                id="gemini-b",
                name="Gemini-B",
                model_name="Gemini 2.5 Flash",
                runtime=DynamicRuntimeWrapper(gemini_b_adapter, config.participant_instructions_path),
                description="Google AI API (独立通道 B)",
            )

        codex_store = JsonThreadStore(config.thread_state_dir / "codex_thread.json")
        codex_adapter = CodexRuntimeAdapter(
            cwd=config.codex_cwd,
            state_store=codex_store,
        )
        registry["codex"] = Participant(
            id="codex",
            name="Codex",
            model_name="Codex App-Server",
            runtime=DynamicRuntimeWrapper(codex_adapter, config.participant_instructions_path),
            description="本地 ChatGPT OAuth 接入",
        )

    default_target = "gemini" if "gemini" in registry else next(iter(registry.keys()), "codex")
    service = ConversationService(history, registry, default_target_id=default_target)

    app = FastAPI(title="Cognos 第一发生场", docs_url=None, redoc_url=None)
    app.state.config = config
    app.state.history = history
    app.state.service = service
    app.state.participants = registry
    app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=FRONTEND_DIR), name="assets")

    @app.get("/api/instructions")
    async def get_instructions() -> dict[str, Any]:
        content = _read_instructions(config.participant_instructions_path)
        return {
            "content": content,
            "path": str(config.participant_instructions_path),
            "length": len(content),
        }

    @app.get("/", include_in_schema=False)
    async def index() -> FileResponse:
        return FileResponse(FRONTEND_DIR / "index.html")

    @app.get("/api/bootstrap")
    async def bootstrap() -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            messages = history.read_all()
        except (HistoryCorruptionError, RuntimeError) as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc

        participant_list = [p.to_dict() for p in registry.values()]
        latest_runtime = next(
            (item.get("runtime_ref") for item in reversed(messages) if item.get("runtime_ref")),
            None,
        )
        return {
            "messages": messages,
            "participants": participant_list,
            "default_target": default_target,
            "state": {
                "latest_runtime_ref": latest_runtime,
                "history_count": len(messages),
                "persistence": "Obsidian Vault / 追加式 JSONL",
            },
        }

    @app.post("/api/messages")
    async def send_message(request: SendMessageRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            result = await service.send(
                request.content,
                target=request.target,
                quoted_occurrence_id=request.quoted_occurrence_id,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
        except RuntimeUnavailableError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=502,
                detail=f"消息已保存，但目标参与者本次未能返回。错误：{exc}",
            ) from exc
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc

        return {
            **result,
            "state": {
                "thread_id": result["reply"]["runtime_ref"]["thread_id"],

def _load_env_file(path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.exists():
        return
    try:
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
                continue
            key, _, val = line.partition("=")
            key = key.strip()
            val = val.strip().strip("'\"")
            if key and key not in os.environ:
                os.environ[key] = val
    except Exception:
        pass

@dataclass
class Participant:
    id: str
    name: str
    model_name: str
    runtime: RuntimeAdapter
    description: str = ""

    def get_thread_id(self) -> str | None:
        if hasattr(self.runtime, "state_store") and hasattr(self.runtime.state_store, "load"):
            st = self.runtime.state_store.load()
            if isinstance(st, str):
                return st
            elif hasattr(st, "thread_id"):
                return st.thread_id
        return None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "name": self.name,
            "model_name": self.model_name,
            "thread_id": self.get_thread_id(),
            "description": self.description,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AppConfig:
    history_path: Path
    thread_state_dir: Path
    codex_cwd: Path
    participant_instructions_path: Path
    gemini_api_key: str | None = None
    gemini_model: str = "gemini-3.7-flash"


class SendMessageRequest(BaseModel):
    content: str
    target: str | None = None
    quoted_occurrence_id: str | None = None


class ConversationService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        history: AppendOnlyHistory,
        participants: dict[str, Participant],
        config: AppConfig,
        default_target_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.history = history
        self.participants = participants
        self.config = config
        self.default_target_id = default_target_id or (next(iter(participants.keys())) if participants else "gemini")
        self._send_lock = asyncio.Lock()

    def _read_instructions(self) -> str:
        try:
            return self.config.participant_instructions_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f"无法读取当前参与说明：{self.config.participant_instructions_path}") from exc

    def resolve_target(self, content: str, requested_target: str | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
        stripped = content.strip()
        for p_id, p in self.participants.items():
            triggers = [f"@{p.name.lower()}", f"@{p_id.lower()}"]
            for trig in triggers:
                if stripped.lower().startswith(trig):
                    rest = stripped[len(trig):].lstrip(" :,，：\n")
                    return p_id, rest or stripped

        if requested_target and requested_target.lower() in self.participants:
            return requested_target.lower(), stripped

        return self.default_target_id, stripped

    async def send(
        self,
        content: str,
        target: str | None = None,
        quoted_occurrence_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not content.strip():
            raise ValueError("消息不能为空")
        if len(content) > 100_000:
            raise ValueError("单条消息暂不能超过 100000 个字符")

        target_id, target_content = self.resolve_target(content, target)
        if target_id not in self.participants:
            raise ValueError(f"未找到指定的参与者：{target_id}")

        participant = self.participants[target_id]
        
        # 动态更新说明
        instructions = self._read_instructions()
        if hasattr(participant.runtime, "developer_instructions"):
            participant.runtime.developer_instructions = instructions

        quoted_record = None
        if quoted_occurrence_id:
            quoted_record = self.history.get_by_id(quoted_occurrence_id)

        if quoted_record:
            q_author = quoted_record.get("author", "未知参与者")
            q_id = quoted_record.get("id", "")
            q_content = quoted_record.get("content", "")
            actual_input = (
                f"[来自当前发生场的已有发生]\n"
                f"occurrence_id: {q_id}\n"
                f"author: {q_author}\n\n"
                f"{q_content}\n"
                f"[/发生]\n\n"
                f"小林：\n"
                f"{target_content or content}"
            )
        else:
            actual_input = target_content or content

        async with self._send_lock:
            user_record = self.history.append_message(
                author="小林",
                content=content,
                target=participant.name,
                target_participant_id=participant.id,
                quoted_occurrence_id=quoted_occurrence_id if quoted_record else None,
            )
            reply = await participant.runtime.send(actual_input)
            
            ai_record = self.history.append_message(
                author=participant.name,
                author_participant_id=participant.id,
                content=reply.text,
                in_reply_to=user_record["id"],
                quoted_occurrence_id=quoted_occurrence_id if quoted_record else None,
                runtime_ref={
                    "runtime": participant.id,
                    "thread_id": reply.thread_id,
                    "turn_id": reply.turn_id,
                },
            )
            return {
                "user": user_record,
                "reply": ai_record,
                "target": participant.to_dict(),
            }


def default_config() -> AppConfig:
    vault_root = Path(
        os.environ.get(
            "COGNOS_VAULT_PATH",
            str(Path.home() / "Documents" / "Obsidian Vault"),
        )
    ).resolve()

    thread_state_dir = Path(
        os.environ.get(
            "COGNOS_THREAD_STATE_DIR",
            str(WEB_DIR / ".state"),
        )
    ).resolve()
    codex_cwd = Path(os.environ.get("COGNOS_CODEX_CWD", str(PROJECT_DIR))).resolve()

    return AppConfig(
        history_path=vault_root
        / "10 Projects"
        / "Cognos"
        / "运行数据"
        / "第一发生场.jsonl",
        thread_state_dir=thread_state_dir,
        codex_cwd=codex_cwd,
        participant_instructions_path=WEB_DIR / "participant_instructions.md",
        gemini_api_key=os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY"),
        gemini_model=os.environ.get("GEMINI_MODEL", "gemini-3.7-flash"),
    )


def create_app(
    config: AppConfig | None = None,
    *,
    runtime: RuntimeAdapter | None = None,
    participants: dict[str, Participant] | None = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    config = config or default_config()
    history = AppendOnlyHistory(config.history_path)

    registry: dict[str, Participant] = {}

    if participants is not None:
        registry = dict(participants)
    elif runtime is not None:
        registry["codex"] = Participant(
            id="codex",
            name="Codex",
            model_name="Codex Runtime",
            runtime=runtime,
        )
    else:
        instructions = config.participant_instructions_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if config.gemini_api_key:
            gemini_store = GeminiStateStore(config.thread_state_dir / "gemini_thread.json")
            gemini_adapter = GeminiRuntimeAdapter(
                api_key=config.gemini_api_key,
                state_store=gemini_store,
                model=config.gemini_model,
                developer_instructions=instructions,
            )
            registry["gemini"] = Participant(
                id="gemini",
                name="Gemini",
                model_name=f"Gemini {config.gemini_model.replace('gemini-', '')}",
                runtime=gemini_adapter,
                description="Google AI API (主通道)",
            )

            gemini_b_store = GeminiStateStore(config.thread_state_dir / "gemini_b_thread.json")
            gemini_b_adapter = GeminiRuntimeAdapter(
                api_key=config.gemini_api_key,
                state_store=gemini_b_store,
                model="gemini-2.5-flash",
                developer_instructions=instructions,
            )
            registry["gemini-b"] = Participant(
                id="gemini-b",
                name="Gemini-B",
                model_name="Gemini 2.5 Flash",
                runtime=gemini_b_adapter,
                description="Google AI API (独立通道 B)",
            )

        codex_store = JsonThreadStore(config.thread_state_dir / "codex_thread.json")
        codex_adapter = CodexRuntimeAdapter(
            cwd=config.codex_cwd,
            state_store=codex_store,
            developer_instructions=instructions,
        )
        registry["codex"] = Participant(
            id="codex",
            name="Codex",
            model_name="Codex App-Server",
            runtime=codex_adapter,
            description="本地 ChatGPT OAuth 接入",
        )

    default_target = "gemini" if "gemini" in registry else next(iter(registry.keys()), "codex")
    service = ConversationService(history, registry, config, default_target_id=default_target)

    app = FastAPI(title="Cognos 第一发生场", docs_url=None, redoc_url=None)
    app.state.config = config
    app.state.history = history
    app.state.service = service
    app.state.participants = registry
    app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=FRONTEND_DIR), name="assets")

    @app.get("/api/instructions")
    async def get_instructions() -> dict[str, Any]:
        content = config.participant_instructions_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        return {
            "content": content,
            "path": str(config.participant_instructions_path),
            "length": len(content),
        }

    @app.get("/", include_in_schema=False)
    async def index() -> FileResponse:
        return FileResponse(FRONTEND_DIR / "index.html")

    @app.get("/api/bootstrap")
    async def bootstrap() -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            messages = history.read_all()
        except (HistoryCorruptionError, RuntimeError) as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc

        participant_list = [p.to_dict() for p in registry.values()]
        latest_runtime = next(
            (item.get("runtime_ref") for item in reversed(messages) if item.get("runtime_ref")),
            None,
        )
        return {
            "messages": messages,
            "participants": participant_list,
            "default_target": default_target,
            "state": {
                "latest_runtime_ref": latest_runtime,
                "history_count": len(messages),
                "persistence": "Obsidian Vault / 追加式 JSONL",
            },
        }

    @app.post("/api/messages")
    async def send_message(request: SendMessageRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            result = await service.send(
                request.content,
                target=request.target,
                quoted_occurrence_id=request.quoted_occurrence_id,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
        except RuntimeUnavailableError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=502,
                detail=f"消息已保存，但目标参与者本次未能返回。错误：{exc}",
            ) from exc
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc

        return {
            **result,
            "state": {
                "thread_id": result["reply"]["runtime_ref"]["thread_id"],
                "turn_id": result["reply"]["runtime_ref"]["turn_id"],
            },
        }

    async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {"status": "ready"}

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient


WEB_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROJECT_DIR = WEB_DIR.parent
PHASE0_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "phase0"
sys.path.insert(0, str(WEB_DIR))

from codex_runtime import RuntimeReply, RuntimeUnavailableError
from server import AppConfig, Participant, create_app


class FakeRuntimeWithInstructions:
    def __init__(self, prefix: str = "fake", thread_id: str = "thread-web") -> None:
        self.prefix = prefix
        self.thread_id = thread_id
        self.developer_instructions: str | None = None

    async def send(self, message: str) -> RuntimeReply:
        return RuntimeReply(
            thread_id=self.thread_id,
            turn_id=f"turn-{self.prefix}-{len(message)}",
            text=f"{self.prefix} 回复：{message} [说明摘要: {str(self.developer_instructions)[:10]}]",
        )


class FakeRuntime:
    def __init__(self, prefix: str = "fake", thread_id: str = "thread-web") -> None:
        self.prefix = prefix
        self.thread_id = thread_id

    async def send(self, message: str) -> RuntimeReply:
        return RuntimeReply(
            thread_id=self.thread_id,
            turn_id=f"turn-{self.prefix}-{len(message)}",
            text=f"{self.prefix} 回复：{message}",
        )


class FailingRuntime:
    async def send(self, message: str) -> RuntimeReply:
        raise RuntimeUnavailableError("offline")


class WebSliceTest(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary_directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        root = Path(self.temporary_directory.name)
        self.instructions_path = root / "participant.md"
        self.instructions_path.write_text("测试说明", encoding="utf-8")
        self.config = AppConfig(
            history_path=root / "vault" / "first-field.jsonl",
            thread_state_dir=root / "state",
            codex_cwd=root,
            participant_instructions_path=self.instructions_path,
        )

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temporary_directory.cleanup()

    async def test_page_and_health_are_available(self) -> None:
        app = create_app(self.config, runtime=FakeRuntime())
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            page = await client.get("/")
            health = await client.get("/api/health")

        self.assertEqual(200, page.status_code)
        self.assertIn("第一发生场", page.text)
        self.assertEqual({"status": "ready"}, health.json())

    async def test_get_instructions_api(self) -> None:
        app = create_app(self.config, runtime=FakeRuntime())
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            response = await client.get("/api/instructions")

        self.assertEqual(200, response.status_code)
        data = response.json()
        self.assertEqual("测试说明", data["content"])
        self.assertEqual(str(self.instructions_path), data["path"])
        self.assertEqual(4, data["length"])

    async def test_dynamic_instructions_update_on_interaction(self) -> None:
        runtime = FakeRuntimeWithInstructions()
        app = create_app(self.config, runtime=runtime)
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            # 1. 初始发送
            res1 = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "第一轮"})
            self.assertEqual(200, res1.status_code)
            self.assertIn("测试说明", runtime.developer_instructions)

            # 2. 更新磁盘上的参与说明文件内容
            self.instructions_path.write_text("更新后的全新品格参与说明", encoding="utf-8")

            # 3. 再次发送消息，验证运行时获取到了最新内容
            res2 = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "第二轮"})
            self.assertEqual(200, res2.status_code)
            self.assertEqual("更新后的全新品格参与说明", runtime.developer_instructions)

    async def test_message_round_trip_is_persisted_across_app_recreation(self) -> None:
        first_app = create_app(self.config, runtime=FakeRuntime())
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=first_app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            response = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "从这里继续"})
            self.assertEqual(200, response.status_code)
            self.assertEqual("thread-web", response.json()["state"]["thread_id"])

        reopened_app = create_app(self.config, runtime=FakeRuntime())
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=reopened_app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as reopened:
            payload = (await reopened.get("/api/bootstrap")).json()

        self.assertEqual(2, len(payload["messages"]))
        self.assertEqual(["小林", "Codex"], [item["author"] for item in payload["messages"]])
        self.assertEqual("从这里继续", payload["messages"][0]["content"])
        self.assertEqual("turn-fake-5", payload["state"]["latest_runtime_ref"]["turn_id"])

    async def test_multi_participant_coexistence_and_routing(self) -> None:
        participants = {
            "gemini": Participant(
                id="gemini",
                name="Gemini",
                model_name="Gemini 3.7 Flash",
                runtime=FakeRuntime(prefix="G", thread_id="thread-gemini-1"),
            ),
            "codex": Participant(
                id="codex",
                name="Codex",
                model_name="Codex App-Server",
                runtime=FakeRuntime(prefix="C", thread_id="thread-codex-1"),
            ),
        }
        app = create_app(self.config, participants=participants)
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            # 1. 小林 -> @Gemini
            res1 = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "@Gemini 第一条消息"})
            self.assertEqual(200, res1.status_code)
            self.assertEqual("Gemini", res1.json()["reply"]["author"])
            self.assertEqual("thread-gemini-1", res1.json()["state"]["thread_id"])

            # 2. 小林 -> @Codex
            res2 = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "@Codex 你看一下 Gemini 的发言"})
            self.assertEqual(200, res2.status_code)
            self.assertEqual("Codex", res2.json()["reply"]["author"])
            self.assertEqual("thread-codex-1", res2.json()["state"]["thread_id"])

            # 3. 再次呼叫 @Gemini，验证 Gemini 的连续性 thread-gemini-1 不受影响
            res3 = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "@Gemini 回到你的连续性"})
            self.assertEqual(200, res3.status_code)
            self.assertEqual("Gemini", res3.json()["reply"]["author"])
            self.assertEqual("thread-gemini-1", res3.json()["state"]["thread_id"])

            # 验证全量历史中有 6 条记录（3条小林 + 2条Gemini + 1条Codex）
            boot = (await client.get("/api/bootstrap")).json()
            self.assertEqual(6, len(boot["messages"]))
            authors = [m["author"] for m in boot["messages"]]
            self.assertEqual(["小林", "Gemini", "小林", "Codex", "小林", "Gemini"], authors)
            self.assertEqual(2, len(boot["participants"]))

    async def test_quoted_occurrence_presentation_across_participants(self) -> None:
        last_received: dict[str, str] = {}

        class RecordingFakeRuntime:
            def __init__(self, prefix: str) -> None:
                self.prefix = prefix
            async def send(self, message: str) -> RuntimeReply:
                last_received[self.prefix] = message
                return RuntimeReply(
                    thread_id=f"thread-{self.prefix}",
                    turn_id=f"turn-{self.prefix}-1",
                    text=f"已阅：{message[:20]}",
                )

        participants = {
            "gemini": Participant(
                id="gemini",
                name="Gemini",
                model_name="Gemini 3.7",
                runtime=RecordingFakeRuntime("G"),
            ),
            "codex": Participant(
                id="codex",
                name="Codex",
                model_name="Codex App-Server",
                runtime=RecordingFakeRuntime("C"),
            ),
        }
        app = create_app(self.config, participants=participants)
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            # 1. Gemini 发言产生发生 A
            res1 = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "这是初始判断", "target": "gemini"})
            gemini_reply_id = res1.json()["reply"]["id"]

            # 2. 小林引用 A 并发送给 Codex
            res2 = await client.post(
                "wp/api/messages" if False else "/api/messages",
                json={
                    "content": "结合代码你看如何？",
                    "target": "codex",
                    "quoted_occurrence_id": gemini_reply_id,
                },
            )
            self.assertEqual(200, res2.status_code)
            self.assertIn("quoted_occurrence_id", res2.json()["user"])
            self.assertEqual(gemini_reply_id, res2.json()["user"]["quoted_occurrence_id"])

            # 验证 Codex 收到的输入包含格式化的发生呈现
            codex_input = last_received["C"]
            self.assertIn("[来自当前发生场的已有发生]", codex_input)
            self.assertIn(f"occurrence_id: {gemini_reply_id}", codex_input)
            self.assertIn("author: Gemini", codex_input)
            self.assertIn("结合代码你看如何？", codex_input)

    async def test_failed_runtime_keeps_original_user_occurrence(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
        app = create_app(self.config, runtime=FailingRuntime())
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            response = await client.post(
                "/api/messages", json={"content": "即使失败也不要抹掉"}
            )
            history = (await client.get("/api/bootstrap")).json()["messages"]

        self.assertEqual(502, response.status_code)
        self.assertEqual(1, len(history))
        self.assertEqual("即使失败也不要抹掉", history[0]["content"])

    async def test_blank_message_is_rejected_without_history(self) -> None:
        app = create_app(self.config, runtime=FakeRuntime())
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            response = await client.post("/api/messages", json={"content": "   \n"})
            history = (await client.get("/api/bootstrap")).json()["messages"]

        self.assertEqual(422, response.status_code)
        self.assertEqual([], history)
